[Benzinga news, 2026-11-02T14:02:27Z, by staff] Dauch Corporation Announces Preliminary Third Quarter 2026 Results and Adjusts Full-Year Guidance
Dauch Corporation reported preliminary third-quarter 2026 financial results and revised its full-year 2026 outlook, citing macroeconomic headwinds including production volatility and rising costs.
Dauch Corporation announced preliminary results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, projecting a net loss between $42 million and $47 million and Adjusted EBITDA between $355 million and $360 million. The company is adjusting its full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA target to a range of $1.350 billion to $1.375 billion, down from its previous guidance of $1.360 billion to $1.425 billion. Additionally, the company updated its full-year 2026 sales target to a range of $10.8 billion to $10.875 billion, compared to the prior range of $10.6 billion to $10.8 billion. Management attributed these adjustments to ongoing macroeconomic challenges, including customer production volatility, inflation, and rising energy costs. A full report of the third-quarter results is scheduled for release on November 6, 2026.
